from.place: proof of Tag 0DJ9: affine case, where the stalkwise condition is equivalent to the derived module base-change isomorphism

title: Affine case of the single-complex derived base-change criterion
statement: Let X=Spec(A), S=Spec(R), S'=Spec(R') and X'=Spec(A') be a cartesian square of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change], with f:X\to S and g:S'\to S, and let K correspond to a complex M^\bullet of A-modules and K' to a complex N^\bullet of A'-modules in the quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. For a prime x' of A', let x be its image in A and let s' and s be their images in R' and R. If for every such x' and every i the canonical stalk map H^i(M^\bullet_x\otimes^L_{R_s}R'_{s'})\otimes_{A_x\otimes_{R_s}R'_{s'}}A'_{x'}\to H^i(N^\bullet_{x'}) is an isomorphism, then the induced derived pullback/direct-image comparison map [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image] M^\bullet\otimes^L_R R'\to M^\bullet\otimes^L_A A'\to N^\bullet is an isomorphism in D(R').
